question.text: An appropriate benchmark for a large-cap equity PMS Investment Approach would be:

explanation.text: The Logic: Large-cap equity portfolios should use comparable large-cap equity benchmarks such as BSE 30 or NIFTY 50. The Trap: Liquid-fund, gold and G-Sec benchmarks do not reflect a large-cap equity universe. Note: Source identifies BSE 30 or NIFTY 50 as appropriate benchmarks for large-cap equity investment.
